# Clipward patch to whisper-rs-sys 0.15.0

This directory is the crates.io `whisper-rs-sys` 0.15.0 source, used through
`[patch.crates-io]` in the workspace `Cargo.toml`, with `whisper.cpp/` swapped
for the latest whisper.cpp release. crates.io whisper-rs-sys bundles 1.8.3
and lags upstream by months. `whisper-rs` 0.16 itself is unchanged.

Licensing: whisper-rs-sys is Unlicense; whisper.cpp is MIT
(`whisper.cpp/LICENSE`). The crates.io metadata files (`.cargo_vcs_info.json`,
`Cargo.lock`, `Cargo.toml.orig`) were dropped.

## Changes

1. `whisper.cpp/`: the release's `CMakeLists.txt`, `LICENSE`, `cmake/`, `ggml/`,
   `include/`, `src/` and `bindings/javascript/package-tmpl.json`, which is the
   subset whisper-rs-sys publishes. ggml backends other than CPU, Metal and
   BLAS are dropped, because CMake only enters a backend folder when its
   `GGML_<NAME>` option is on.
2. `build.rs` `get_whisper_cpp_version`: whisper.cpp 1.9 declares
   `set(WHISPER_VERSION_MAJOR 1)` and so on instead of
   `project("whisper.cpp" VERSION x.y.z)`. This spot is marked `CLIPWARD PATCH`.

Bindings are generated by bindgen at build time, so they follow the headers.

## Updating

```sh
scripts/update-whisper-cpp.sh          # latest release
scripts/update-whisper-cpp.sh v1.9.5   # a specific tag
```

Then run `cargo build` and the engine tests, and re-run the transcription
bench on real videos before shipping, because a whisper.cpp update can change
accuracy.
